procedure: tone at --freq; the meter re-levelled at the fixed codes first; per code: the register written, 20 ms, re-level (source moved in 6 dB steps, backoff first, every move recorded), reading; after a stage its register goes back to the fixed code. A gain difference between codes = (meter difference) + (source difference) in the record
